title: Personal Checking: bank-error refund of an extended overdraft fee
content:
## Situation and business effect

This entry applies to a Personal Checking account that carries an extended overdraft fee, the one-time fee charged on a negative episode once the balance has stayed negative for the tier's trigger period. It governs whether that fee was charged in error and so whether it is returned to the owner as a bank-error correction. When a refund is owed the agent posts it: the refund appears in the owner's account activity immediately and the posted ledger balance rises by the refunded amount. When none is owed, nothing is posted under this entry.

## Invocation

The refund is posted through **refund_extended_overdraft_fee_22b46ecc**, an internal tool. The agent must unlock it first (unlock_agent_discoverable_tool) and then call it (call_agent_discoverable_tool).

**Business effect of a call.** One call writes one refund entry on the account, dated today, that refunds the named extended overdraft fee entry, records the refund as a bank-error correction for the extended overdraft fee, and raises the account's posted ledger balance by the refunded amount at once. The tool records exactly the amount given against the named fee and does not check the fee, its date, its amount or any earlier refund.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Class | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|---|
| checking_account_id | Id | The checking account on which the extended overdraft fee was charged, as the checking account lookup returns it | Reference number |
| customer_id | Id | The customer reference number of the account's owner, as the customer profile lookup returns it | Reference number |
| source_item_id | Id | The extended overdraft fee entry that is being refunded, as the checking activity lookup returns it | Reference number |
| amount | Fixed format | Refund in U.S. dollars; positive | Plain number, two decimal places, rounded half-up (for example 12.34) |
| statement_cycle | Fixed format | Statement cycle that today's posting falls in | YYYY-MM for the month in which the cycle closes |

## Return

The tool returns a confirmation sentence naming the new refund entry reference number, the fee entry it refunds, the amount refunded in USD with 2 decimal places, and the account's new posted ledger balance in USD with 2 decimal places. Receiving it means the refund is posted.

## Calling contract Q&A

**Q: Is source_item_id the overdraft item fee that began the episode?**
A: No. It is the extended overdraft fee entry being refunded.

**Q: Will the tool stop a second refund of the same fee?**
A: The tool does not check any earlier refund; it records exactly what it is given.

**Hypothetical call (illustrative references only):** checking_account_id "CHK-EXAMPLE", customer_id "CUST-EXAMPLE", source_item_id "EXO-EXAMPLE", amount 30.00, statement_cycle "2026-07". The receipt names the new refund entry, fee EXO-EXAMPLE, 30.00 USD refunded and the new ledger balance.
